agent.explain: An agent failed, not the code or its provider.
agent.label: Agent

delivery.explain: The work was done, but delivering it (push, pull request) failed.
delivery.label: Delivery

orchestration.explain: Zeroshot itself failed, not the code or the agents.
orchestration.label: Orchestration

provider.explain: The model provider's side: not answering, a broken stream, an outage, a usage or rate limit. Usually temporary.
provider.label: Provider

setup.explain: The run is set up wrong (credentials, model, tools); retrying unchanged fails the same way.
setup.label: Setup

work.explain: The agents did the work, but a reviewer did not accept it.
work.label: Work
